title: PCG orders 18,000 liters of fuel removed from vessel stuck in Leyte

blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — Authorities have ordered the removal of 18,169 liters of fuel from a cargo vessel that ran aground off Tood Island in Bato, Southern Leyte, before it can be towed to safety, after five safety deficiencies were found aboard the ship. The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) said removing fuel from MV GY Antares is part of its recovery plan, as discussed on Thursday during a meeting of Coast Guard personnel, the vessel’s master, and representatives from the local government and the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR).
